venira.avoid_when: you only need its declaration (project_outline_symbol) or arbitrary text (project_search).
venira.speed_profile: fast for scope=file; medium for scope=workspace (single search call).
venira.use_when: you check where a symbol is used before renaming or changing it.

description:
Find occurrences of a symbol name. scope=file needs relative_path (one file); scope=workspace (default) searches all files. limit caps the workspace scan, max_references caps the returned list.
Use when: you check where a symbol is used before renaming or changing it.
Avoid when: you only need its declaration (project_outline_symbol) or arbitrary text (project_search).
Output: count, references[] {relative_path, line_number, context}.

limit.description: scope=workspace only: max search hits to scan (default 50). Ignored for scope=file.

max_references.description: Max references returned (default 100, max 500). Applies in both scopes.

relative_path.description: Required when scope=file; with scope=workspace it narrows the search to this subtree.

scope.description: workspace = search all files (default); file = search one file. scope=file requires relative_path.

symbol_name.description: Symbol name to find (matched as a whole word).

name: project_symbol_references
title: Symbol references
